question: A block exerts a thrust of 500 N on a surface of area 0.25 { m}² . The pressure exerted by the block is _______.
solution: The correct answer is __**2000 N/m²**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The formula for calculating **pressure** is: **Pressure = Force / Area**. • In the given problem, the block exerts a **force (thrust)** of **500 N** on a surface with an **area** of **0.25 m²**. • Using the formula: **Pressure = 500 N / 0.25 m²**. • The result is: **Pressure = 2000 N/m²**. • **Hence, the pressure exerted by the block is 2000 N/m².**
